correctness.rationale: Two directed orientations of the unique undirected cycle are the only minimal forbidden faces. They cannot coexist. Each forbidden face has precisely three compatible exterior incidence vertices, with link an edge plus isolated point. The simplex–link quotient is an n-fold suspension of S0, giving two S^n cofiber summands. An independent signed integer relative-chain computation yields, for each orientation, ranks 1,3,1 with primitive differentials and single H_n=Z. Exact enumeration for n=3 through 10 corroborates every local block; all-n proof is combinatorial, not experimental.

value.rationale: The 2022 source explicitly motivates using generalized Morse topology to understand ordinary Morse complexes, and proves a single-leaf collapse. The new result identifies the sharp effect of a second pendant edge, for infinitely many cycle lengths and all integral relative degrees, with two orientation-indexed primitive obstructions. This all-length map-level fact is not implied by the prior finite absolute-space calculation and can be used via exact sequences to compare integral classes in neighboring complexes. Exact narrow structural boundaries are mathematically motivated even without a downstream large theorem.
